shared_elements: schematic linear incision used alongside raised relief
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with profile animals and at least one horizontal band of repeated units, and both include a plain circular/disc element among the figures. But A is a dense, continuous horizontal narrative frieze with modelled, anatomically detailed humans, horses and a wheeled vehicle, whereas B is a tall vertical block bearing sparse, flat-planed, highly schematic isolated creatures against empty ground — the rendering, format and density of imagery differ fundamentally.
